```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

```{r setup}
library(BayCausal)
```

# Basic setup

```{r}
seed <- 0
P_star <- 1
Nit <- 10000
burn <- 5000
thin <- 10
```

# Generate toy data

```{r}
data <- generate_toy_data(include_C = FALSE)
data$P <- 0L
data$L <- matrix(0, data$Q, 1)
data$C <- matrix(0, data$n, 1)
```

# Set up prior, initial values, and chain

```{r}
mh_setup_lst <- set_mh_default()
prior_lst <- set_prior_default(data, 1)
init_lst <- set_init_default(seed, P_star, data, prior_lst)
chain_setup_lst <- set_chain(Nit, burn, thin, seed)
```

# Run the algorithm

```{r}
res <- glvcausal(data, mh_setup_lst, init_lst, prior_lst, chain_setup_lst, FALSE)
```

# Result

## P_star

### Truth

The true value of P_star is `r data$P`.

### MCMC

```{r}
P_star_samples <- extract_P_star(res)
table(factor(P_star_samples, levels = 0:prior_lst$H))
mean(P_star_samples == 0)
```

## B

### Truth

```{r}
round(data$B, 2)
```

### MCMC

```{r}
round(extract_post_mean_all(res, "B"), 2)
```

## L

### Truth

```{r}
round(data$L, 2)
```

### MCMC

```{r}
P_star_mode <- get_mode(P_star_samples)
P_star_mode
round(extract_post_mean(res, "L", P_star_mode), 2)
```

### L post processed

```{r}
res_processed <- post_process_L(res, order_flag = TRUE, pos_sign = TRUE,
                                cutoff = 0.1)
P_star_mode_processed <- get_mode(extract_P_star(res_processed))
round(extract_post_mean(res_processed, "L", P_star_mode_processed), 2)
```

### P_star post processed

```{r}
table(factor(extract_P_star(res_processed), levels = 0:prior_lst$H))
```
